name: Requests
description: Clustered feature requests (frequency/weighted score are derived, not stored)

agentPrompts.label: Cluster new feedback into requests
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-feedback` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then dedupe and cluster the `triage: new` feedback into request drafts — title, problem statement, proposed spec summary, and representative feedback ids — and write the cluster assignment via `scripts/apply_clusters.mjs`. Never write `frequency` or `weighted-score` directly; they always recompute client-side from linked feedback.

agentPrompts.label: Set the effort estimate for a request
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-feedback` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then set the effort estimate I give for the request I name.

agentPrompts.label: What are people asking for the most?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-feedback` skill in this folder, then show me the requests with the highest frequency and weighted score, their trend, and status, with representative quotes. Never invent or inflate a count — it must derive from real linked feedback.
